verdict.rationale: mParticle documents Data Privacy Controls for GDPR consent and CCPA opt-out, including forwarding rules like 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt-out is present,' and general GDPR/CCPA compliance docs exist. However, there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated user deletion/erasure request workflow (e.g., a 'Data Subject Request' API) that is forwarded to connected destinations—only consent/opt-out state management is documented. Missing for 10: explicit deletion/suppression request API or workflow documentation, evidence of deletion forwarding to specific destinations, and independent confirmation of this working in practice.
